chunks: He said: "O you nobles, is there any one of you who can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
ai.seo_question: What did Solomon ask his nobles regarding the throne of Sheba?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah An-Naml, Prophet Solomon (AS) addresses his council of jinn and men, demonstrating his political acumen by seeking a voluntary display of power rather than immediate conquest. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a moment of strategic patience, where the ultimate goal is not just the transfer of the throne but the 'submission' (Islam) of the Queen, emphasizing that true authority leads to spiritual recognition. The request underscores the hierarchy of his kingdom and the miraculous nature of his control over both human and jinn advisors.
